data.body: **[P2] Preserve empty-checkpoint coalescing in mixed batches.** Once a non-empty synchronous update sets `has_blocked_caller`, this branch continues using the 1 ms timeout even after a synchronous empty checkpoint joins the batch. A regular update immediately ahead of a map/parallel resume wave can therefore split empty checkpoints arriving more than 1 ms apart into extra API requests, regressing their intended coalescing and increasing throttling/latency risk. Track synchronous empty checkpoints separately and let the full coalescing window take precedence, with a regression test covering staggered empty arrivals after a non-empty sync update.
